The Role


Linktree is evolving from a link-in-bio tool to the place creators and businesses run everything — a control center that helps them understand what's working across platforms and decide what to do next. Linktree's users live on their phones, and native mobile is where a huge amount of that value gets delivered: capturing content on the go, staying on top of their audience, getting coached in the moment on how to grow. We're raising our mobile bar across the whole product, and we need a Staff designer to lead that craft.

Why This Role Matters


This is our mobile craft anchor. Every experience pillar owns its own mobile and web surfaces — your job is to be the designer who sets and raises the native bar across all of them. It's a cross-pillar, influence-heavy role: you'll go deep where native truly wins and keep the app feeling like one coherent product, not five disconnected ones — so every pillar's mobile work gets better.

content:
The Role

As Head of Operations Engineering at Linktree, you’ll shape how the company works and scales. You’ll combine operational expertise, technology and change management to help teams move faster, make better decisions and deliver more consistent outcomes.

Your remit will span everything from transforming a team’s daily workflows to rethinking how the business plans, collaborates and executes. You’ll identify where work gets stuck, where automation can free up people’s time and where better systems can open up new possibilities. You’ll have the scope to uncover opportunities, build support across the business and take improvements from an idea through to lasting change.

You’ll lead a small engineering team and own the internal platform and mission-critical tools that turn those opportunities into working solutions. Just as importantly, you’ll help teams build the skills and confidence to improve their own ways of working, making AI and automation part of everyday operations.

This is an opportunity to make improvements that reach across Linktree: turning a successful change in one team into something the whole business can benefit from. You’ll stay close to the work, partner with people across functions and see your impact in what teams can achieve.

The Role


We’re looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead our Activation team — the team focused on helping more users successfully get started with Linktree, experience value quickly, and become engaged, retained users.
You’ll lead a small, cross-functional engineering squad working at the heart of our growth funnel, partnering closely with Product, Design, and Data to identify opportunities, run experiments, and ship experiences that improve activation and drive meaningful user and business outcomes.

This is a player-coach role for someone who enjoys staying close to the work. You’ll combine strong people leadership with hands-on technical contribution — guiding architecture, prototyping solutions, reviewing critical work, and writing code when it helps the team move faster.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and mentor a high-performing engineering squad focused on improving activation and early user experiences.
  • Stay hands-on technically, contributing code, prototyping solutions, and jumping into critical technical work when it helps unblock the team or accelerate delivery.
